title: Evaluation of Oral Collagen Peptides on Skin Barrier Function in Women
official: Evaluation of Oral Collagen Peptides on Skin Barrier Function in Women With Dry Skin
summary: This clinical study aims to determine whether taking two different doses of collagen-derived peptides for three months improves facial skin barrier integrity in women with dry, sensitive skin, compared with a placebo.
sponsor: Centre de Pharmacologie Clinique Applique a la Dermatologie
